text:
marie: Heads-up — scheduled cross-service release tonight 22:00 UTC. Plan: API v2.3.1, runtime 4.8.0 (kernel batch changes), router 2.1.0, console 1.9.7. Change window 22:00–23:30 UTC. Need pin/rollback plan + owners. @sam @lee @anya

sam: noted. main concern = runtime kernel change. If router/console expect old KV semantics we should consider temporary pin on router.

tom-deploy-bot: PRE-FLIGHT: /deploy check results
- api v2.3.1: ok
- runtime 4.8.0: WARN kernel-batching mismatch on router compatibility
- router 2.1.0: ok
- console 1.9.7: ok
Canaries configured: EU 10% -> US 30% -> AP 60% -> 100%
Locks: none
Suggested rollback triggers: p50 latency +30%, error rate >1% sustained 3m

lee: if we pin router back to 2.0.9 we will block one console streaming convenience change. Is that acceptable for the window?

anya: console can gate streaming via feature flag temporarily. We can flip streaming_flag=false for the rollout window. Minimal UX impact for early adopters.

marie: decision: pin router to 2.0.9 for the window; keep runtime 4.8.0 but enable conservative kernel mode on runtime nodes (RW_KERNEL_MODE=compat). Update release notes and ops playbook. Owners: sam (runtime), lee (router), anya (console).

tom-deploy-bot: ACTION: applying pin -> router:2.0.9. Deploy plan updated. Staged rollout w/ holds: 10/30/60/100 with 10m holds. Rollback criteria set. Notifying on-call.

ops-bot: on-call rotation set for this rollout: sam -> lee -> anya. Paging thresholds: error rate 1% / p50 +30%.

sam: running staging integration: `./scripts/integration_check.sh --router 2.0.9 --runtime 4.8.0 --api 2.3.1`

sam: staging run: KV eviction rate spikes ~5% under synthetic sustained load. Testing conservative cache: `KV_CACHE_MAX=0.6`

lee: console smoke passed with streaming_flag=false locally.

anya: pushing rollout config: `streaming_flag=false` scheduled 21:45 UTC. Will monitor telemetry.

marie: release-notes draft PR #423 includes summary, pins, rollback runbook, owners. @sam pls review the rollback steps in the PR.

sam: reviewed and approved.

tom-deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled at 2532101200 UTC. Will post canary progress updates here.

marie: quick reminder: rollback command format `deploy-bot rollback <service> <prev-version>`. If we rollback, notify #incidents and ping on-call.

lee: ack, I'll be ready to roll back router.

anya: I'll watch console errors + telemetry dashboards.

tom-deploy-bot: CANARY: EU -> 10% started at 2532101300. Metrics snapshot: errors 0.1%, p50 +2% :thumbsup:

sam: EU perf nominal.

tom-deploy-bot: CANARY: US -> 30% at 2532101360. Metrics: errors 0.9%, p50 +15%

marie: p50 +15% approaching warning threshold. Hold rollout and investigate.

sam: investigating — US runtime nodes show kernel GC pauses correlated with new kernel path. Rolling compat kernel mode to US cluster now.

tom-deploy-bot: ENV UPDATE: RW_KERNEL_MODE=compat applied to us cluster at 2532101385.

tom-deploy-bot: POST-CHANGE METRICS (us): errors 0.3%, p50 +4% — recovering.

marie: good recovery. proceed with next step when steady for full hold duration.

tom-deploy-bot: CANARY: AP -> 60% started at 2532101420.

anya: console telemetry stable, no spike in error budget.

tom-deploy-bot: FINAL ROLL -> 100% scheduled at 2532101500.

marie: final status: release complete. Notes: router pinned to 2.0.9 during window; runtime conservatively configured (RW_KERNEL_MODE=compat) in us for initial 30m; console streaming flag gated. Release notes: https://git.internal/redwood/pr/423

sam: follow-up: open a runtime postmortem to track kernel GC regression and plan for kernel-mode performance toggles.

lee: will revert pin after 23:30 UTC if metrics stable.

tom-deploy-bot: cleanup: pin removed for router at 2532102100 (planned), will post final metrics summary to the release thread.

marie: thanks all — great coordination. :tada:
